nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What practices contribute to the injustices perpetuated by financialised food systems?
nodes.answer: Exploitative labour practices, weak regulatory protections, and land-grabbing contribute to the injustices perpetuated by financialised food systems, especially in the global South.
